method: Rendered every page of both booklets with music_pages.py render at 110 dpi (32 PNGs in /private/tmp/claude-501/music-second-reader-2014ol/listening and /composing) and read every ask page in full on the render (listening 2-6 and 8-11, composing 3-11); the pages the file lists without asks (listening 1, 7, 12-16; composing 1, 2, 12-16) were checked on a contact sheet and in the text layer (covers, BLANK PAGE, ROUGH WORK only). PyMuPDF clips at 250-400 dpi of every question-block line on every ask page, settling in particular: the en dashes in "Bars 1–16" (p2 Excerpt 1 and 2 headings), "bars 1–8" / "bars 9–16" (p3), "lines 1–2" (p4), "bars 1–16" and "(bars 11–12)" (p5), "lines 1–2 and lines 3–4" and "lines 9–10 ... lines 7–8" (p11); the hyphens in "sixty-four", "non-traditional" and "eight-bar"; the curly apostrophes in "When I’m Sixty Four", "I’d", "I’m", "You’ll" (p4), "You’ll Never Walk Alone", "don’t", "you’ll" (p11, lyrics and the italic circle line, which has no full stop); "THREE" in capitals throughout; "Q. 5 Irish Music" (no full stop) against "Q. 6 Aural Skills." (full stop); the bare bold "Excerpt 1/2/3" headings (no full stop) on p3, p8 and p9 against "Excerpt 1./2./3." on p2, p10 and p11; Q5 Excerpt 2(iii) "Give a reason for your answer" printed WITHOUT a full stop; "Identify" in Q6 Excerpt 3(v) (first two letters set smaller, still capital I + lower-case d); the bullets of every lead-in (the left-margin bullets of "The lyrics are printed below." on p10 and p11 included); the Section A stem (full stops after "Q3." and "sections.") and the Section B stem (no full stop after "Q6"); "In the case of both (a) and (b)," (comma) and the three bullets printed once for both parts of composing Q1, with each part's instrument list printed beside its label (a) / (b); the unbulleted "(a) Study this opening of a waltz." / "(b) Study this opening of a march." lines of Q3; "key note" as two words in Q2(b); the unbulleted poem lines (p4); "PREPARATORY WORK" in plain capitals; the flat sign in "B♭ major" (p6; the text layer's "b" is in the OpusText music font, the page draws a flat); and the em dashes in the four cadence lines "(I—V—vi)", "(vi—IV—I)", "(IV—ii—V)", "(ii—V—I)" (p7). Every questionText, questionContext, excerptLine and grid.stem string was also split at its bullets, newlines and tick boxes and matched as an exact, case-sensitive substring of the PyMuPDF text layer of its pages (whitespace collapsed); the only misses were the B♭ line (text layer "Bb", settled on the render), the Q4(i) blank (see its entry), and lead-ins / stems printed on an earlier page than the ask's "pages" (Q5 Excerpt 3, Q6 Excerpt 3, Section A Q2-Q3 and Section B Q5-Q6 stems), each found on the earlier page. Every string was scanned for straight quotes, ASCII dashes, double or trailing spaces: none. The file has no readFromPage field (the B♭ reading is recorded only in Section B Q4's notes, for the lane lead). Addresses were checked against the printed numbering: Q1, Q5 and Q6 number their parts afresh under each excerpt (Q1 Excerpt 1-3 (i)-(iii); Q5 Excerpt 1 (i)-(ii), Excerpt 2 (i)-(iii), Excerpt 3 (i)-(iii); Q6 Excerpt 1 (i)-(iii), Excerpt 2 (i)-(iv), Excerpt 3 (i)-(v)); Q2-Q4 (i)-(v); Section A Q1-Q3 (a)/(b); Section B Q4-Q6. All 53 addresses match the print, and every printed ask has one.
